items: Add a .dockerignore, or you ship .git and node_modules into the build context
Pin tags, and prefer a digest when you need reproducibility
Keep one concern per image rather than a process supervisor inside it

blocks.content:
RUN addgroup -S app && adduser -S app -G app
USER app

blocks.title: Secrets do not belong in layers
blocks.content: An ARG or a copied .env stays in the image history forever, even if a later instruction deletes the file. Use build secrets or inject at runtime.
